{{Quote|Admiral Peilaeon, initially preoccupied with a protracted campaign against Adumar, eventually stopped his enemy from advancing into the heart of the Empire, though the effort cost him the Super Star Destroyer ''Reaper''.|[[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>}}
The '''Battle of Celanon''' was a conflict between the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]] at [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]]. Under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], the Imperial forces had been pushed back in an attempt to contain an invasion of Imperial space. During the battle, Pellaeon lost his [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]], the [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Reaper (Executor-class)|''Reaper'']].

==Background==
Following the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Battle of Nam Chorios|victory]] against [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tol Getelles|Getelles]] of the [[Antemeridian sector/Legends|Antemeridian sector]], the New Republic [[Invasion of the Antemeridian sector|pushed]] through the neutral [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Borderland Regions]] toward the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], border of the [[Imperial Space]]. The Moffs of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], fearing the shift of power in the region, ordered [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] to move his forces across the Hydian Way.<ref name="TEA" /> Torn away from his [[Campaign against Adumar|campaign]] against the planet [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]], Pellaeon brought his forces into the fight against the New Republic.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> The losses he inflicted on the New Republic were substantial, but Pellaeon was pushed back.<ref name="TEA" />

==The battle==
At [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]], Pellaeon once again engaged New Republic forces. He was not able to secure a victory, however, and lost his [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]], the [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Reaper (Executor-class)|''Reaper'']].<ref name="TEA" />

==Aftermath==
In the wake of Celanon, the New Republic refrained from pushing its advantage and halted the invasion. The New Republic had increased its power in the Borderland Regions, but the Empire hadn't lost much territory. This battle was followed by four years of relative peace between the two factions.<ref name="TEA" />
